question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

Spellbound
solution:
The correct answer is **'Disenchanted'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Spellbound **is a verb which means to hold the complete attention of (someone) as though by magic; fascinate.
 
• The meaning of the given options are as follows - 
 
 
• **Amazed **- surprise (someone) greatly; fill with astonishment.
 
• **Captivated **- attract and hold the interest and attention of; charm.
 
• **Enthralled **- capture the fascinated attention of.
 
• **Disenchanted **- disappointed by someone or something previously respected or admired; disillusioned.
 
 
 
• From the above meanings it is evident that **disenchanted **is the correct antonym for the word **spellbound**.
 
• Hence, **option 4 **is the correct answer.
